description.zh:
前缀列表的地址族。取值范围：

- IPv4。
- IPv6。

默认值：空，查询所有前缀列表信息。
description.en:
The IP address family. Valid values:

- IPv4

- IPv6

This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that all prefix lists are queried.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results. Set the value to the `NextToken` value returned in the last call to this operation. Leave this parameter empty the first time you call this operation.
The IDs of prefix lists. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.
The name of the prefix list.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 前缀列表所属的企业资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the prefix list belongs.
The tags of the prefix list.

description.zh: 前缀列表的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含`http://或者https://`。
description.en: The key of tag N of the prefix list. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain `http:// or https://`.

description.zh:
前缀列表的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。该值可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://或https://`。
description.en:
The value of tag N of the prefix list. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http:// or https://`.

descriptions.zh: 请求参数`AddressFamily`、`PrefixListId.N`和`PrefixListName`类似于过滤器，为逻辑与（AND）关系。如果某一参数为空，则过滤器不起作用。
descriptions.en: You can specify the `AddressFamily`, `PrefixListId.N`, and `PrefixListName` request parameters in the request. Specified parameters have logical AND relations. Only the parameters that you set are included in the filter conditions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-prefix-lists --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --prefix-list-name PrefixListNameSample --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 10 --address-family IPv4 --prefix-list-id pl-x1j1k5ykzqlixdcy0000 --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribePrefixLists --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF20000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --PrefixListId.1 'pl-x1j1k5ykzqlixdcy0000' --PrefixListName PrefixListNameSample --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AddressFamily IPv4
